title: The scripts generated from the notebooks are not in the manifest of the regeneration
author: Claude-JG
description: tools/regenerate.py reports python/Examples/notebooks/*.py, which notebookEmitter.py writes from python/Notebooks/*.ipynb, as drift outside both tiers (unexpected) when a notebook changes. To be checked: add them to the manifest, probably as tier 2 like the generated notebook pages.
releaseNotes: The scripts of the notebooks in python/Examples/notebooks are in Tier 2 of tools/regenerate.py, as the pages of the notebooks: a changed script is a warning, a new one that is not in git a hard gate.
